description:
The Copperhead S is built for riders who want raw trail power—a Class‑3 eMTB with 140mm rear travel, a 140mm air fork, and the Bosch Performance Line Speed motor that rockets you up to 28 mph with authority. Its 27.5+ setup delivers massive traction and control, while the BES3 PowerTube 750Wh battery keeps you charging through long days on technical terrain. This is the do‑everything trail machine for riders who want speed, agility, and all‑mountain capability in one package.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Bosch Performance Line Speed Gen4 (Smart System), 28 mph Class‑3 assist.

Battery: Bosch PowerTube 750Wh for maximum range and long‑distance trail days.

Display: Bosch Purion 200 - compact, clean, and easy to read on rough terrain.

Suspension and Frame

Rear Shock: Suntour Edge X SV 2CR Trunnion, 180×55mm, delivering 140mm of plush rear travel.

Fork: Suntour Lytro‑34 Air BOOST 2CR, 140mm travel, Boost 110 spacing, black stanchions.

Frame: BULLS alloy full‑suspension frame with hydroformed downtube, forged linkage, and internal cable routing.

Drivetrain and Brakes

Gearing: Shimano CUES 10‑speed with RD‑U6000 Shadow Plus derailleur and 11–48T cassette — smooth, durable, and trail‑ready.

Crankset: Samox 38T narrow‑wide chainring with 160mm crank arms for ideal ground clearance.

Brakes: Shimano MT200 hydraulic disc brakes with a 203mm front rotor and 180mm rear rotor for confident stopping power.

Wheels and Tires

Rims: BULLS DDM‑12 double‑wall alloy rims, 30mm inner width — perfect for 27.5+ traction and stability.

Tires: Schwalbe Wicked Will Performance 27.5×2.6 (65‑584), folding, ADDIX compound — fast‑rolling with excellent grip.

Additional Features

Dropper Post: Limotec Z1 dropper (100–150mm travel depending on frame size) with Shimano MT500 remote.

Cockpit: 760mm alloy handlebar, 50–70mm stem (size‑specific), ergonomic VELO grips.

Pedals: Wellgo ZZE‑01M MTB pedals with reflectors.

MonkeyLink Ready: Magnetic front and rear reflectors + ML interface cables included.
